#Pathway Z-Score Bar Plots
```{r}
# Read the IPA z-scores of the canonical pathways. Each column compares a time point with the previous one,
# so the values are changes, not levels. IPA "N/A" (z-score not computable) stays missing: no bar
comparisons <- c("8_vs_0", "72_vs_8", "120_vs_72", "128_vs_120", "144_vs_128", "168_vs_144")

ipa_cp_long <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "Sequential Comparsion LFC 0.5 p 0.001 MT CP.csv"), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = "N/A") %>%
  mutate(`Canonical Pathways` = case_when( # Shorten some names
    `Canonical Pathways` == "The citric acid (TCA) cycle and respiratory electron transport" ~ "TCA & Respiratory Electron Chain",
    `Canonical Pathways` == "Acetyl-CoA Biosynthesis I (Pyruvate Dehydrogenase Complex)" ~ "Acetyl-CoA Biosynthesis I",
    TRUE ~ `Canonical Pathways`
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -`Canonical Pathways`, names_to = "comparison", values_to = "z") %>%
  mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = comparisons, labels = gsub("_", " ", comparisons))) # x labels "8 vs 0", ...

# One fixed colour per pathway
pathway_colors <- c("TGF-β Signaling" = "#D55E00", "Signaling by BMP" = "#0072B2", "p53 Signaling" = "#009E73",
                    "TCA & Respiratory Electron Chain" = "#E69F00", "Mitochondrial biogenesis" = "#56B4E9",
                    "Acetyl-CoA Biosynthesis I" = "#CC79A7", "Cellular response to hypoxia" = "#0072B2")
```

```{r}
# Function plotting IPA pathway z-scores as bars, one bar per comparison and pathway
# The black outline keeps a computed z = 0 visible as a line. legend_xy puts the legend inside the panel (NULL = no legend)
plotPathwayBar <- function(pathways, title, legend_xy = NULL) {

  dat <- ipa_cp_long %>%
    filter(`Canonical Pathways` %in% pathways) %>%
    mutate(`Canonical Pathways` = factor(`Canonical Pathways`, levels = pathways))

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = comparison, y = z, fill = `Canonical Pathways`)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") + # IPA threshold |z| >= 2
    geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) + # Dediff induction at 120h
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"), width = 0.75,
             colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 4)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pathway_colors) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Comparison (hours)", y = "Activation z-score", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(color = "darkblue", size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(color = "darkblue", size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "darkblue", size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = if (is.null(legend_xy)) "none" else "inside",
      legend.position.inside = legend_xy,
      legend.justification = legend_xy,
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Fig. 3A: TGF-β, BMP and p53 signalling. 3A and 3B are 8 x 5.5 in, the two ~100 mm panels of the Fig. 3 top row
tgfb_bmp_p53_bar <- plotPathwayBar(pathways = c("TGF-β Signaling", "Signaling by BMP", "p53 Signaling"),
                                   title = "TGF-β, BMP and p53",
                                   legend_xy = c(0.01, 0.99)) # Top left

tgfb_bmp_p53_bar

ggsave(filename = "TGF-β, BMP and p53 bar.png", plot = tgfb_bmp_p53_bar, width = 8, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 1200, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 3B: metabolic pathways. TCA and Acetyl-CoA have a z-score only at 120 vs 72
metabolic_bar <- plotPathwayBar(pathways = c("TCA & Respiratory Electron Chain", "Mitochondrial biogenesis", "Acetyl-CoA Biosynthesis I"),
                                title = "Metabolic Changes",
                                legend_xy = c(0.99, 0.99)) # Top right

metabolic_bar

ggsave(filename = "Metabolic Changes bar.png", plot = metabolic_bar, width = 8, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 1200, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 5E: cellular response to hypoxia. 6.5 x 2.8 in for the ~84 x 36 mm slot under the HIF2A panel (5D),
# so no x-axis title and horizontal comparison labels
hypoxia_bar <- plotPathwayBar(pathways = "Cellular response to hypoxia", title = "Cellular Response to Hypoxia") +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

hypoxia_bar

ggsave(filename = "Cellular Response to Hypoxia bar.png", plot = hypoxia_bar, width = 6.5, height = 2.8, units = "in", dpi = 1200, bg = "white")
```


#Upstream Regulators Z-Score Plots
```{r}
list.files(dir)

ipa_ur_raw <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "Sequential Comparsion LFC 0.5 p 0.001 MT UR.csv"), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE) 


# Get top 20
ipa_ur <- ipa_ur_raw[1:20, ]

# Replace NA with zero for plotting
ipa_ur[ipa_ur == "N/A"] <- 0


# Set row names and remove the column
rownames(ipa_ur) <- ipa_ur[, "Upstream Regulators"]
ipa_ur <- ipa_ur[, colnames(ipa_ur) != "Upstream Regulators"]



# Ensure it's a matrix
ipa_ur <- as.matrix(ipa_ur)
```

```{r}
plotRegulator <- function(name, cellwidth, cellheight, height, width) {
  
  # Convert to numeric
  rownames <- rownames(ipa_ur)
  ipa_ur <- apply(as.matrix(ipa_ur), 2, as.numeric)
  rownames(ipa_ur) <- rownames
  
  # Get the range of values for color mapping
  min_val <- min(ipa_ur, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_val <- max(ipa_ur, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Create color mapping same as pheatmap
  col_fun = colorRamp2(
    breaks = seq(min_val, max_val, length = 7),
    colors = rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu"))
  )

  
  # Set up PNG device
  png(
    filename = paste0(name, ".png"),
    width = width,      
    height = height,      
    units = "in",
    res = 1200       
  )
  
  
  
  # Create heatmap
  ht <- Heatmap(
    as.matrix(ipa_ur), 
    name = "Upstream Regulators", 
    col = col_fun,
    column_title = name, 
    row_title = "IPA Upstream Regulators",
    
    # Clustering settings
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    
    # Legend settings
    show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "UR Activity Z-Score",
      legend_direction = "vertical",
      legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
      title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
      legend_gap = unit(2, "cm")
    ),
    
    # Size and appearance
    width = unit(cellwidth, "cm"),
    height = unit(cellheight, "cm"),  # 6
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13),  # 20
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11), # 15
    
    
    # Additional settings
    column_split = c(rep(1, 3), rep(2, ncol(ipa_ur) - 3)),
    border = TRUE
  )
  
  # Draw the heatmap with extended padding and legend placement
  draw(
    ht, 
    padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "cm"),  # top, right, bottom, left padding
    heatmap_legend_side = "left"           # Ensure legend is placed on the right side of the heatmap
  )
  
  # Close the PNG device
  dev.off()
  
  # Return the heatmap object invisibly
  return(invisible(ht))
}
```

```{r}
plotRegulator("Top 20 IPA Upstream Regulators", 
              cellwidth = 12, cellheight = 20, 
              width = 9, height = 10)
```
